intro: 26.7 will be cut directly off master. This is everything merged since 26.6.0 was tagged, minus the patch and the release commits.

native.baseline: 26.6.0 tag, 6 June (merge-base of master and release/26.6)
native.note: release/26.6 is what is in production: master at the cut plus the 26.6.1 backport. App store approval is not visible in git, so the published GitHub release is the strongest in-repo signal.

web.next: web/26.7.0, tagged off master when ready
web.baseline: web/26.6.0, 5 June (newest web tag that is on master)
web.in_window: 16 user-facing web PRs merged to master
web.note: web/26.6.1 and web/26.6.2 are cherry-pick lineages, each carrying one feature-flag flip. app.fedi.xyz serves /api/features to both apps, so a flag deploy is a web deploy. They are not the baseline; web/26.6.0 is.

backport.headline: Patch 26.6.1 is going out first with 2 fixes, and those are not counted here.
backport.note: PR #11593 cherry-picks these onto release/26.6. They are on master too, but they reach users as the patch rather than as part of 26.7.

summary.title: Group chats you can ask to join, emoji reactions, and a nudge to back up your wallet
summary.lede: The web app catches up on chat: reactions, message actions and requesting to join a private group. The native app gets a backup reminder and a run of crash and layout fixes.
quirks: Reactions and message actions reach the web app only. The native app already has them.

release_notes.store: Ask to join private groups, react to messages, and get a reminder to back up your wallet, plus bug fixes.

features.headline: Request to join private and community groups
features.summary: People will be able to ask to join a private group, and admins can review those requests.

features.headline: Personal backup reminder
features.summary: A reminder that nudges people to back up their wallet. Built and ready, held behind a feature flag.

fixes.headline: Payments above your balance are stopped clearly
fixes.summary: You cannot confirm a payment your balance does not cover.

sections.title: Only for federation creators
sections.note: Creating a federation is switched off in the app, and turns on for a phone that opens the creation link.

features.headline: See which guardians are not responding
features.summary: The dashboard lists each guardian by name as online or not responding.

not_merged.headline: The app opens on older iPhones (iOS 15)
not_merged.summary: A crash on launch on iOS 15 is fixed.

not_merged.headline: Separate history entries for reused on-chain addresses
not_merged.summary: Each deposit to a reused address gets its own line in history.

items.name: Stable Balance on the web app
items.does: Web app users get Stable Balance.
touch: The Wallet page shows a switcher between bitcoin and Stable Balance, for federations that offer Stable Balance.
With Stable Balance picked, the balance, history, Receive and Send all use Stable Balance. With the flag off, the page always shows bitcoin.
The wallet picker lists a Stable Balance option under each wallet that offers it.

items.name: Private groups with join requests
items.does: Ask to join a private group, and an admin approves.
touch: Creating a private group shows an Allow join requests switch, on by default. Without the flag every new private group is invite-only.
Admins of a private group can turn join requests on or off from its invite screen. Without the flag the switch is hidden.

Opening a link or QR code for a private group shows its name and whether you can ask to join. Without the flag every private group shows a generic title and a request button, and an invite-only group refuses the request after it is sent.
Opening a group you have not joined shows a preview. Without the flag, private groups fail to open and the app sends you back.
Asking to join and approving requests work with the flag on or off, for groups already set to accept requests.

items.name: Reactions in chat
touch: Reactions show as bubbles with a count under each message. Without the flag no reactions show, including ones sent from other chat apps.
Tapping a reaction shows who reacted and lets you add or remove your own. A plus button opens the full emoji picker.
Long-pressing a message shows a row of quick reactions above Reply. On the web, right-clicking does the same. Without the flag the row is hidden.
In a chat where you cannot post, right-clicking or long-pressing a message opens a sheet with only reactions. Without the flag nothing opens.

items.name: Backup reminders
items.does: New wallets get a reminder to back up.
touch: A full-screen reminder to back up opens on the Wallet or Spaces tab. It shows for new accounts that have not backed up, once they hold 210 sats or 30 days have passed.
The app counts the 30 days and remembers the 210 sats mark while the flag is off. Anyone who already qualifies sees the reminder as soon as the flag turns on.

items.name: Update prompt
items.does: Anyone on an old version is asked to update.
touch: At launch, the app looks up the newest Fedi release.
A full-screen page announcing the new release opens at launch, once for each new version.
A banner to update sits at the top of the Spaces, Chat, Mini Apps and Wallet tabs while the app is out of date.
Settings shows a card with an Update button while the app is out of date.
